overall_assessment: QuickPark has identified a real problem with good market data and shows early traction with 1,200 downloads and pilot partnerships. The biggest gaps are lack of clear business model/revenue streams, minimal founder credentials, and missing investment terms. The company needs to detail how they'll monetize beyond vague 'payment features' and provide concrete financial projections.

sections.name: Summary
sections.content: QuickPark is a mobile app that helps drivers find parking in busy Malaysian cities. We use technology to solve the parking problem. Our app is available on iOS and Android and we are growing fast. We believe parking is a huge market and we can become the number one parking app in Malaysia.
gaps: What specific technology differentiates QuickPark from existing parking apps?

sections.name: Problem
sections.content: Malaysian drivers waste an average of 20 minutes per trip searching for parking in city centres. In KL alone, there are over 2.5 million registered vehicles competing for approximately 500,000 parking spaces in the city centre. This leads to: Traffic congestion (30% of city traffic is caused by drivers circling for parking), Lost productivity (estimated RM 2.4 billion annually in wasted time), Environmental impact (unnecessary emissions from circling vehicles), Driver frustration (parking is consistently rated the #1 pain point for KL commuters in surveys by DBKL).

sections.name: Solution
sections.content: QuickPark is a smart parking app. Drivers can use our app to find available parking spots nearby. We use sensors and data to show real-time availability. The app is very easy to use and drivers love it. We also plan to add payment features in the future.

sections.name: Market
sections.content: The parking market in Malaysia is very large and growing. More cars are being sold every year, and cities are getting more congested. Smart parking is a global trend and Malaysia is ready for this technology. We believe we are well-positioned to capture a significant share of this growing market.

sections.content: We want to be the leading smart parking platform in Southeast Asia. Parking should be easy, not stressful. We dream of a future where no one has to circle the block looking for a spot.
